# @dxtmisha/figma-code

> Structured TypeScript abstraction layer for Figma Plugin main thread (backend) development.

Provides object-oriented wrappers around native Figma node APIs, persistent storage management with memory caching and expiration aging, text extraction for AI localization, and bidirectional messaging dispatch with UI iframes.

## Key Classes & Utilities

### Messaging & Node Abstractions
- [FigmaPluginMessenger](src/classes/FigmaPluginMessenger.ts): Main thread messaging singleton (`getInstance()`) for handling UI requests and dispatching responses.
- [FigmaItem](src/classes/FigmaItem.ts): High-level wrapper for Figma nodes providing type checks, parent traversal, property extraction, screenshot capture, and SVG export.
- [FigmaFrame](src/classes/FigmaFrame.ts): Frame-specific wrapper for layout structure, children traversal, and computed style tokens.
- [FigmaTopLevelFrames](src/classes/FigmaTopLevelFrames.ts): Manager for extracting, caching, and serving top-level canvas frame lists to the UI.
- [FigmaFramesSelected](src/classes/FigmaFramesSelected.ts): Canvas selection manager synchronizing active node IDs with UI selections.

### Storage Persistence
- [FigmaStorage](src/classes/FigmaStorage.ts): Node- and document-level persistent storage (`setPluginData`) with memory caching and TTL aging.
- [FigmaStorageData](src/classes/FigmaStorageData.ts): In-memory data container managing cached values, age timestamps, and serialization.
- [FigmaClientStorage](src/classes/FigmaClientStorage.ts): Plugin-level persistent storage wrapper around `figma.clientStorage`.

### Text Processing & Setup Handlers
- [FigmaAiText](src/classes/FigmaAiText.ts): Text analysis and extraction module for AI-driven localization, character counting, and codegen workflows.
- [getFigmaFrameById / getFigmaItemById / getFigmaItemByIdOrRoot](src/functions/getFigmaItemById.ts): Node lookup helpers returning typed wrappers or falling back to `figma.root`.
- [setupClientStorage / setupStorage / setupFrameSelection / setupFrameStyles](src/functions/setupStorage.ts): Standard IPC request listeners registering backend responders for UI queries.
